name: Cardiac optogenetic stimulation
target: electrically excitable cardiac cells or tissue
description: Research perturbation using light-sensitive genetically encoded actuators to control cardiac excitation with defined spatial and temporal parameters.
context: cardiac electrophysiology, engineered tissue and regenerative integration research

name: Cardiac optoelectronic photostimulation
target: cardiac cells interfaced with photoconductive or optoelectronic material
description: Research perturbation using a light-responsive material interface to modulate cardiac activity without requiring a genetically encoded opsin.
